meaning.zh:
“俭以防匮” 或 “不浪费就不会缺乏”。

这个短语意指如果你不浪费任何东西，你就永远不会缺乏任何东西。这句话鼓励人们节约资源、珍惜物品，以避免未来的匮乏和需要。这种思想可以追溯到古代的节约美德，在家庭和社会生活中广泛应用。
meaning.en: This phrase means if you don't waste anything, you will never be in need. It encourages people to save resources and cherish their belongings to avoid future shortages and needs. This concept dates back to ancient thrift virtues and is widely applied in both household and social life.

lines.en: *Waste not, want not* is a principle my parents taught me from a young age.
lines.zh: 我的父母从小就教我 “俭以防匮” 的道理。

lines.en: By following the *waste not, want not* rule, we managed to save a lot of money over the years.
lines.zh: 通过遵循 “不浪费就不会缺乏” 的原则，我们多年下来省了不少钱。

lines.en: Grandma always said, *waste not, want not*, and she lived a very modest but fulfilling life.
lines.zh: 奶奶总是说，“俭以防匮”，她过着非常简朴但满足的生活。
